svg.title: Campus Cards · Set 01 · Santa Barbara · 03/12 Coal Oil Point (Rare)
svg.desc: Dunes and a slough at the west end of Isla Vista. Small shorebirds nest here; walk around them. Unofficial. An independent PointCast art project about places. Not affiliated with, sponsored by, or endorsed by the University of California or any campus. No university logos, seals, mascots, or marks are used.
